task.title: Configure application settings with ConfigMaps and Secrets
task.shortdesc: Inject configuration and sensitive values into Pods using ConfigMaps and Secrets.

step.cmd: Create a ConfigMap from literals or a file: kubectl create configmap <cmName> --from-literal=KEY=VALUE -n <ns>.
Create a Secret (generic): kubectl create secret generic <secretName> --from-literal=PASSWORD='<value>' -n <ns>.
Patch or edit the Deployment to consume values as env vars (example): kubectl set env deploy/<app> --from=configmap/<cmName> -n <ns>.
Edit the Deployment manifest to mount the Secret or reference specific keys (kubectl edit deploy/<app> -n <ns>).
Restart Pods to pick up changes if required: kubectl rollout restart deploy/<app> -n <ns>.
Verify env/config is present in a running Pod: kubectl exec -n <ns> deploy/<app> -- printenv | grep KEY.
